network.warning: Allows this app to connect to the internet and send or receive data, which could transmit your information to remote servers or download untrusted content.

storage.warning: Allows this app to read and write files in its own private storage area.

system.warning: Allows this app to read and write files anywhere in the console storage, including files belonging to other apps and the system, which could corrupt your data or compromise the console. Grant only to trusted apps.

filesystem_read.warning: Allows this app to read files outside its own storage, which could expose your saves, configuration, and other apps' data.

filesystem_write.warning: Allows this app to modify or delete files outside its own storage, which could corrupt your saves, other apps, or system files.

device_info.warning: Allows this app to read identifying information about your console, such as serial number, firmware version, or hardware IDs, which could be used to track your device.

account.warning: Allows this app to read your account or profile information, such as username and linked identities, which could expose your identity.

external_links.warning: Allows this app to open external URLs or launch other apps, which could redirect you to untrusted content.
